A cost identity is useful: total observed cost equals discovery plus execution plus verification plus review plus integration and operations plus measured rewor
nodes.paragraph: A cost identity is useful: total observed cost equals discovery plus execution plus verification plus review plus integration and operations plus measured rework and learning investment. Expected loss from defects can be added as a separately modeled risk term, provided probabilities and severities are labeled as assumptions or estimates. This is an engineering interpretation of \workposs{W095} reliability-and-cost proposal and \workposs{W145} DORA ROI guidance; neither provides a validated universal formula.

nodes.label: The production-stage differences examined in Chapter~\ref{chap:02} make this economically consequential. Demirer, Musolff and Yang\textquotesingle s observation
nodes.paragraph: The production-stage differences examined in Chapter~\ref{chap:02} make this economically consequential. Demirer, Musolff and Yang\textquotesingle s observational and structural analysis distinguishes coding activity from projects and releases; its estimates are not a forecast for this service. Use the endpoint relevant to the decision, and preserve the source-version limits in Appendix~\ref{app:methodology}. \autocite{W010}

nodes.label: Quality research demands estimator-level scrutiny. Agarwal and colleagues \autocite{W001} stratify agent adoption by prior IDE use: complexity rises 34.85\% and
nodes.paragraph: Quality research demands estimator-level scrutiny. Agarwal and colleagues \autocite{W001} stratify agent adoption by prior IDE use: complexity rises 34.85\% and 42.87\% in two separate matched cohorts, not in a measured pooled 39\%-effect population. He and colleagues \autocite{W004} report preferred DiD warning and complexity effects of +30.26\% and +41.64\% in 806 Cursor adopters, but their Appendix Table~6 finds \emph{negative, non-significant} quality estimates under an alternative estimator. The two studies share part of their methodological lineage. Neither static warnings nor complexity establishes actual exploited defects, and such observational contrasts must not be pooled into a product-quality or safety guarantee.

nodes.label: Four modes are worth comparing: human-led execution, interactive pair assistance, a bounded agent producing a candidate for review, and a bounded agent followed
nodes.paragraph: Four modes are worth comparing: human-led execution, interactive pair assistance, a bounded agent producing a candidate for review, and a bounded agent followed by an independent checker. Their costs differ in developer minutes, inference, verifier effort, review time and expected rework. Their acceptance probabilities can also differ, but those probabilities must come from a comparable local pilot or remain explicit scenario assumptions. \autocite{W095} motivates this decision structure; \autocite{W028} supplies adoption context, while \autocite{W017} is a cross-domain experiment and cannot be counted as direct evidence of programming productivity.

nodes.label: Cui and colleagues\textquotesingle{} field experiments provide evidence about task output under a particular coding-assistant rollout. Chapter~\ref{chap:02} pre
nodes.paragraph: Cui and colleagues\textquotesingle{} field experiments provide evidence about task output under a particular coding-assistant rollout. Chapter~\ref{chap:02} presents the aggregate estimate and its uncertainty. A local economic model must additionally measure reviewer effort, released outcomes and maintenance obligations, rather than use the reported task gain as a lifetime-return multiplier. \autocite{W003}

nodes.label: DORA\textquotesingle s ROI guidance \autocite{W145} is useful for structuring a business case, but scenario assumptions are not experimentally measured returns.
nodes.paragraph: DORA\textquotesingle s ROI guidance \autocite{W145} is useful for structuring a business case, but scenario assumptions are not experimentally measured returns. METR\textquotesingle s 2026 survey \autocite{W020} provides an example of why value and speed cannot be equated: 349 retained convenience-sample respondents reported about 1.4--2-fold median value increases across differently worded questions but around threefold perceived task-speed improvement. Their answers describe subjective counterfactuals and future expectations, not measured releases or accepted business outcomes. McKinsey\textquotesingle s twentyfold \emph{potential} agent-factory illustration \autocite{W028} likewise is not a verified ROI or a probability of acceptance. A local evaluation should compare modes on homogeneous tasks, retain failures and abandonment, and record reviewer effort and follow-up rework. Randomization is preferable where practical; staged rollout and matched comparisons require stronger assumptions.

nodes.label: A build-versus-buy story is useful only after its scope is made explicit. Orosz's account of replacing his own small testimonials service describes a bounded pe
nodes.paragraph: A build-versus-buy story is useful only after its scope is made explicit. Orosz's account of replacing his own small testimonials service describes a bounded personal implementation, not the lifetime cost of operating an equivalent service \oroszcite{P084}. The approval service has obligations after its first patch: policy updates, independent verification, replay guarantees, monitoring and a responsible owner. Feature similarity alone does not price those obligations.

nodes.label: Simon Eskildsen's discussion of rough systems estimates, interviewed by Orosz, provides a complementary habit: challenge assumptions before accepting a benchmar
Brynjolfsson, Chandar and Chen\textquotesingle s Stanford Digital Economy Lab paper \autocite{W125}, revised August 12, 2026, analyzes administrative payroll da
nodes.paragraph: Brynjolfsson, Chandar and Chen\textquotesingle s Stanford Digital Economy Lab paper \autocite{W125}, revised August 12, 2026, analyzes administrative payroll data covering millions of US workers through June 2026. It reports no evidence of widespread economy-wide displacement, but finds that employment for workers aged 22--25 in AI-exposed occupations is approximately 19\% below the trajectory implied by less-exposed peers. This is a relative comparison under the authors\textquotesingle{} model, not a 19\% national employment decline or proof that AI alone caused the gap. Earlier versions had different estimates and observation windows.

nodes.label: Other mapped research on firm adoption \autocite{W123}, Norwegian outcomes \autocite{W128} and Finland \autocite{W129} uses different populations and outcome me
nodes.paragraph: Other mapped research on firm adoption \autocite{W123}, Norwegian outcomes \autocite{W128} and Finland \autocite{W129} uses different populations and outcome measures. The primary ETLA Working Paper 135 examines Finnish earnings-registry and Labor Force Survey trends through September 2025, comparing the 22--25 and 26--30 age bands across occupational AI-exposure quantiles. Its Figures~3 and 7 show \emph{no persistent divergence} in youth employment by AI exposure, while Figure~8 finds no persistent exposure-based wage gaps. This is a geographically and temporally scoped null pattern, not proof of zero impacts or a randomized AI-adoption test. It is an important counterpoint to US hiring findings and cannot be averaged with job postings or AI-use surveys. \autocite{W129}

nodes.label: The research literature must test alternative causes. Lambert and Schindler's June 2026 LSE Discussion Paper~2193 \autocite{W131} links 243 million new hires an
nodes.paragraph: The research literature must test alternative causes. Lambert and Schindler's June 2026 LSE Discussion Paper~2193 \autocite{W131} links 243 million new hires and 407 million job postings across the US, UK, Canada and Australia, 2017--2025. Separate exposure-gradient specifications associate two-standard-deviation increases in either generative-AI or work-from-home (WFH) exposure with about \textbf{five percentage points less junior hiring share} and \textbf{three points less low-experience vacancy share}. In jointly adjusted models, \emph{WFH remains predictive while the AI coefficient attenuates substantially and is often statistically insignificant} (abstract and specification discussion around printed pp.~12--13). Their continuous-exposure difference-in-differences requires an exposure-parallel-trends assumption; the result flags omitted-variable risk, not definitive proof that remote work caused all junior hiring change. Other job-posting counterpoints \autocite{W139,W140,W142} remain separate candidate explanations.

nodes.label: Garicano and Rayo model conditions under which apprenticeship remains viable as expertise and production technology change. The result is theoretical and depend
nodes.paragraph: Garicano and Rayo model conditions under which apprenticeship remains viable as expertise and production technology change. The result is theoretical and depends on the model\textquotesingle s assumptions, not a measured threshold for a team\textquotesingle s training budget. Appendix~\ref{app:methodology} distinguishes the related manuscript versions. The practical question is how to preserve the learning work on which later expertise depends. \autocite{W119}

nodes.label: Ide \autocite{W120} supplies a theoretical mechanism for learning-path disruption: automation can reduce novice--expert collaboration and future tacit knowledge
nodes.paragraph: Ide \autocite{W120} supplies a theoretical mechanism for learning-path disruption: automation can reduce novice--expert collaboration and future tacit knowledge under specified equilibrium assumptions, with countervailing scale effects possible. A paper's theorem is not an estimated reduction in junior developer hiring. Humlum and Vestergaard \autocite{W136} instead use linked Danish adoption-survey and administrative outcomes; the March 2026 institutional working-paper revision reports small, precisely estimated short-run null wage and hours effects (the authors state effects above about two per cent can be excluded over the observed two-year period), alongside changes in task allocation. This audit inspected the March 13, 2026 RFBerlin original PDF beyond its abstract: the linked design samples approximately 25,000 workers at 7,000 workplaces in 11 exposed occupations; administrative outcomes run through December 2024. In Section 3, Equation (3) adds adopter-specific time trends and clusters standard errors at workplace--occupation level; Figure 5 reports that its dynamic earnings confidence intervals exclude changes larger than about 3\%, while the pooled specification in Figure 7(a) excludes larger than about 2\%. The two precision thresholds refer to \emph{different estimators}. Employer initiatives correlate with usage (approximately 41\% ever-use without initiatives versus 93\% with all three), which is descriptive and must not be read as randomized encouragement. The full coefficient tables and Statistics Denmark person-level microdata have \emph{not} been independently reconstructed here; the precision claims are verified as printed statements, not rerun regression results.

The starting collection is \emph{The SE \& AI Annotated Bibliography}, curated by Alfonso Fuggetta, Damian Andrew Tamburri and Alessandro Margara at \emph{Softw
nodes.paragraph: The starting collection is \emph{The SE \& AI Annotated Bibliography}, curated by Alfonso Fuggetta, Damian Andrew Tamburri and Alessandro Margara at \emph{Software Engineering @ PoliMi}. Its 193 works, organized into nine thematic streams, provide a broad map of research about AI and software engineering. The collection, original classifications and annotations belong to its curators; the engineering argument and teaching case in this book are a separate synthesis. \autocite{SEPolimiAnnotated2026}

nodes.label: The SE \& AI Annotated Bibliography: 193 works on AI and software engineering, in nine streams
Three examples make the distinction concrete. An ambiguity score can direct attention to incomplete or conflicting statements, but the scoring dimensions, aggre
nodes.paragraph: Three examples make the distinction concrete. An ambiguity score can direct attention to incomplete or conflicting statements, but the scoring dimensions, aggregation and decision threshold need their own evaluation. This book supplies no validated readiness score. A Convergence Review can reveal assumptions and competing reasons; agreement between its models is not an independent oracle. The general-model error research discussed in Chapter~\ref{chap:08} motivates examining dependence, but does not supply a coding-specific error rate for that review procedure. \autocite{W079}

nodes.label: An Adversarial Agent changes the questions asked of the candidate, while a protected oracle changes which expectations the maker can alter. Those are different
nodes.paragraph: An Adversarial Agent changes the questions asked of the candidate, while a protected oracle changes which expectations the maker can alter. Those are different properties. The buggy-code and self-review studies examined in Chapter~\ref{chap:07} illuminate particular programming failure modes; they do not validate every maker--checker arrangement. The local replay example instead demonstrates a narrower proposition: the deliberately wrong candidate passes its circular check and fails the independently specified stored-response check. Its file-broker and manifest tests concern the programmed permission and freshness predicates, not authenticated production authority. \autocite{W077,W101}

nodes.label: Program-comprehension studies remind us that engineering includes reconstructing meaning before editing. Xia and colleagues observe professional work across too
nodes.paragraph: Program-comprehension studies remind us that engineering includes reconstructing meaning before editing. Xia and colleagues observe professional work across tools; Minelli, Mocci and Lanza examine activity in a more specialized development environment. Their designs and populations differ, but both make understanding visible as work that a count of changed lines would miss. Neither study is an experiment on present-day coding agents. \autocite{W170,W176}

nodes.label: Version details matter even for this familiar point. The author-hosted W170 manuscript describes 79 developers and 3,244 hours; the final version reports 78 and
nodes.paragraph: Version details matter even for this familiar point. The author-hosted W170 manuscript describes 79 developers and 3,244 hours; the final version reports 78 and 3,148 after a participant's 96 hours were excluded. Some published project counts still total 79, and the retained activity shares have not been independently recomputed from the participant logs. The general observation that comprehension occupies substantial attention should therefore not be converted into an exact universal schedule for developers. \autocite{W170}

nodes.label: For the approval service, understanding why a historical decision must survive a policy change is part of the work, even when the implementation is only a few l
nodes.paragraph: For the approval service, understanding why a historical decision must survive a policy change is part of the work, even when the implementation is only a few lines. Corporate rollout experiments such as W003 can measure output from introducing a coding assistant, but do not by themselves define whether that output is an operable business change. The book's broader work unit makes this remaining effort explicit; it is an engineering choice informed by the evidence. \autocite{W003}

nodes.label: Cui and colleagues combine three company experiments involving 4,867 developers. The frequently cited pooled output estimate is not interchangeable with an esti
nodes.paragraph: Cui and colleagues combine three company experiments involving 4,867 developers. The frequently cited pooled output estimate is not interchangeable with an estimate of assignment to treatment over a restricted period. Noncompliance and the distinction between assignment and actual use affect what is being estimated. Reading only a headline percentage would conceal those choices. \autocite{W003}

nodes.label: The experienced-maintainer experiment catalogued as W023 addresses a different setting. Its primary design involves sixteen developers and 246 issues, with rand
nodes.paragraph: The experienced-maintainer experiment catalogued as W023 addresses a different setting. Its primary design involves sixteen developers and 246 issues, with random assignment at the issue level and developers working in both conditions. Its task-time result should be interpreted within that population, repository familiarity and tested tool setting, rather than treated as the answer to every productivity question. The contrast with a workplace rollout is informative precisely because the settings and endpoints differ. \autocite{W023}

nodes.label: Enterprise surveys, broad practitioner surveys and vendor telemetry can explain adoption and perceived usefulness. They cannot substitute for timed work, review
nodes.paragraph: Enterprise surveys, broad practitioner surveys and vendor telemetry can explain adoption and perceived usefulness. They cannot substitute for timed work, reviewer effort or post-release outcomes when those are the quantities a decision requires. Reports of confidence or speed belong beside the measured outcomes, with their own response denominator. \autocite{W007,W022,W021}

nodes.label: The AIDev dataset supports systematic examination of agent activity. Several publications reuse that corpus, including the analyses by Khelifi and colleagues an
nodes.paragraph: The AIDev dataset supports systematic examination of agent activity. Several publications reuse that corpus, including the analyses by Khelifi and colleagues and by Peralta and colleagues. Their questions and samples differ, but the common lineage matters when assessing independent support. Peralta's review-trace sample and manually inspected subset are selections from an observed population, not fresh randomized trials. \autocite{W192,W068,W071}

nodes.label: MirrorCode explores longer-horizon task capability, while Whitfill and colleagues investigate why benchmark-passing patches may still fail maintainer expectatio
nodes.paragraph: MirrorCode explores longer-horizon task capability, while Whitfill and colleagues investigate why benchmark-passing patches may still fail maintainer expectations. The latter assessment omits a normal iterative pull-request-and-CI cycle, so it does not estimate an actual production merge probability. Bhati's lifecycle synthesis, in turn, organizes earlier work rather than supplying another independently randomized sample. \autocite{W193,W111,W095}

nodes.label: A test can be precise and still ask the wrong question. W148's simulated function-development processes illustrate this when an articulated requirement and a na
nodes.paragraph: A test can be precise and still ask the wrong question. W148's simulated function-development processes illustrate this when an articulated requirement and a narrower supplied oracle disagree. A candidate may satisfy one interpretation and fail the other. The lesson is to inspect the authority behind the expected result, not merely count passing cases. \autocite{W148}

nodes.label: Intent-prediction and drift-scoring work such as W099 examines the effort involved in keeping model behavior aligned with a changing requirement. Its scoring co
nodes.paragraph: Intent-prediction and drift-scoring work such as W099 examines the effort involved in keeping model behavior aligned with a changing requirement. Its scoring costs and nonrandomized rollout do not establish a universally effective retry rule or an automated authority for deciding intention. Process proposals by Hassan and Hoda offer useful ways to organize responsibilities, while the repository-policy study W150 records written obligations rather than runtime compliance. \autocite{W099,W152,W153,W150}

nodes.label: The benchmark changes between versions of W151 also constrain what can be inferred from its results. An earlier edition describes $\tau$-bench; a later edition
nodes.paragraph: The benchmark changes between versions of W151 also constrain what can be inferred from its results. An earlier edition describes $\tau$-bench; a later edition uses a TravelPlanner constraint task. Those headlines are not repeated measurements on an unchanged benchmark. Some reported seed summaries also lack the observations and endpoint definitions needed for reconciliation. The control ideas can be discussed without treating those unresolved comparisons as validated performance estimates. \autocite{W151}

nodes.label: A change can pass its immediate tests while making the next change harder. Observational studies of agent-first and IDE-first repositories, and of Cursor adopti
nodes.paragraph: A change can pass its immediate tests while making the next change harder. Observational studies of agent-first and IDE-first repositories, and of Cursor adoption, examine this possibility through activity, complexity and static-analysis measures. W001 distinguishes its repository groups rather than estimating a single pooled ``39\%'' complexity effect. W004's quality results also vary materially with estimator choice: an alternative specification gives negative, statistically insignificant estimates where the preferred one reports increases. These are reasons to investigate maintainability, not to declare a tool universally harmful. \autocite{W001,W004}

nodes.label: Redundancy adds another perspective. Huang and colleagues report a higher redundancy measure for agentic pull requests alongside relatively favorable review-com
nodes.paragraph: Redundancy adds another perspective. Huang and colleagues report a higher redundancy measure for agentic pull requests alongside relatively favorable review-comment sentiment. That combination can motivate a check for missed reuse, but the sentiment classifier does not establish what a reviewer understood. A discrepancy between the complexity-table total and the surrounding reported count further limits precise reuse of that table; it does not erase the separately reported redundancy comparison. \autocite{W031}

nodes.label: Post-merge studies help distinguish a warning from work that actually follows. W029 reports introduced SonarQube issues in merged Python bug fixes, with highly
nodes.paragraph: Post-merge studies help distinguish a warning from work that actually follows. W029 reports introduced SonarQube issues in merged Python bug fixes, with highly unequal agent-group sizes and concentrated findings. W054 follows changes over ninety days and examines outcomes including reverts. A raw vendor total, an issue-presence test, an issue-density test and a revert comparison answer different questions. Reconstructing the approximate revert odds ratios from rounded published percentages checks that arithmetic, not the original model or its handling of selection. \autocite{W029,W054}

nodes.label: The practical response is to keep architecture and maintenance evidence separate from a passing test. A duplicated Treasury threshold imposes a synchronization
nodes.paragraph: The practical response is to keep architecture and maintenance evidence separate from a passing test. A duplicated Treasury threshold imposes a synchronization obligation even when its cyclomatic complexity is low. Authorship and ownership records may identify a steward, but do not prove that the steward can diagnose and safely revise the behavior. An explicit handoff and a change-focused fitness check address that gap. \autocite{W189}

nodes.label: The often-repeated 45\% failure figure in W061 concerns eighty constructed tasks under the tested models and judging procedure. Schreiber and Tippe instead iden
nodes.paragraph: The often-repeated 45\% failure figure in W061 concerns eighty constructed tasks under the tested models and judging procedure. Schreiber and Tippe instead identify publicly attributed AI code through GitHub searches and successive filtering, then examine patterns reported by CodeQL. Attribution comments are unevenly used, and detected patterns are not verified exploits. Neither design supplies the base rate of exploitable flaws in an arbitrary deployed organization. \autocite{W061,W041}

nodes.label: A written contribution policy can require review without demonstrating that a runtime prevents secret reads, network actions or direct merges. The selected repo
nodes.paragraph: A written contribution policy can require review without demonstrating that a runtime prevents secret reads, network actions or direct merges. The selected repository policies in W150 illuminate governance language, not enforcement of those boundaries. \autocite{W150}

nodes.label: Independence concerns where an expected answer comes from. A second model can repeat the first model's mistake, especially when both share incomplete context or
nodes.paragraph: Independence concerns where an expected answer comes from. A second model can repeat the first model's mistake, especially when both share incomplete context or related failure patterns. W079's conditional agreement result concerns multiple-choice answers when both models are wrong. It motivates caution about consensus, but is not an overall coding-agent failure rate. W148's oracle anomalies and W111's maintainer judgments make the complementary point that even executable correctness can be narrower than the acceptance question. \autocite{W079,W148,W111}

nodes.label: Xiang and colleagues evaluate writer/reviewer combinations on the same 116 complete-case programming tasks. The reviewing models cannot run the tests that later
nodes.paragraph: Xiang and colleagues evaluate writer/reviewer combinations on the same 116 complete-case programming tasks. The reviewing models cannot run the tests that later score correctness. In that setting, reviewer order matters: one sequence adds passing tasks to its writer-only baseline, while the reverse loses successes and costs more. Reconstructed McNemar calculations use the published discordant counts, not independently rerun model outputs. The result illustrates why another review stage needs evaluation; it does not establish an optimal brownfield review process. \autocite{W102}

nodes.label: Statistical checks have an oracle problem of their own. W151 reports a difference in mean constraint satisfaction and invokes a paired McNemar test without the
nodes.paragraph: Statistical checks have an oracle problem of their own. W151 reports a difference in mean constraint satisfaction and invokes a paired McNemar test without the categorical discordance table needed to reproduce it. Means alone do not determine those paired outcomes. A plausible reconstruction must therefore remain a hypothesis until the relevant observations are available. \autocite{W151}

nodes.label: Human-review studies can likewise measure trust, agreement and time without measuring escaped production defects. Those outcomes matter, but cannot certify the
nodes.paragraph: Human-review studies can likewise measure trust, agreement and time without measuring escaped production defects. Those outcomes matter, but cannot certify the service's release. Its checker needs an expectation grounded in the authorized contract and evidence tied to a particular candidate. \autocite{W066}

nodes.label: Watanabe and colleagues describe 567 Claude Code pull requests across 157 projects, including merge and modification patterns. Other studies examine interventio
nodes.paragraph: Watanabe and colleagues describe 567 Claude Code pull requests across 157 projects, including merge and modification patterns. Other studies examine intervention, review context and reasons for rejection. Peralta's manually inspected rejected cases distinguish agentic failures, non-agentic workflow causes and unknown reasons. The sample is stratified, and missing traces can hide work. These classifications describe what was observable; they are not a population-wide estimate of how often humans should intervene. \autocite{W036,W068,W065,W071}

nodes.label: Counting also requires care. W072's same-product and cross-product review groups overlap, so summing them overcounts distinct pull requests. W068 has an unresol
nodes.paragraph: Counting also requires care. W072's same-product and cross-product review groups overlap, so summing them overcounts distinct pull requests. W068 has an unresolved discrepancy between a table's category total and its stated overall count. An arithmetically plausible replacement cell does not become a corrected observation without the underlying records. \autocite{W072,W068}

nodes.label: Automation-bias research offers mechanisms for understanding over-reliance on advice, but its adjacent settings do not supply a safe software-review threshold.
nodes.paragraph: Automation-bias research offers mechanisms for understanding over-reliance on advice, but its adjacent settings do not supply a safe software-review threshold. Intent scoring introduces its own costs, and a self-selected rollout cannot isolate its deployment benefit. \autocite{W085,W087,W099}

nodes.label: A repository preserves code more readily than the reasoning that shaped it. Comprehension research, industrial ownership succession and discussions of generated
nodes.paragraph: A repository preserves code more readily than the reasoning that shaped it. Comprehension research, industrial ownership succession and discussions of generated-code authorship all suggest different ways of examining that problem. They do not establish that one graph format, memory store or AI-generated summary improves the next maintainer's performance. \autocite{W170,W185,W189}

nodes.label: Completing an assisted task is not the same observation as explaining it unaided or applying the lesson later. The main W118 experiment assesses participants im
nodes.paragraph: Completing an assisted task is not the same observation as explaining it unaided or applying the lesson later. The main W118 experiment assesses participants immediately after work with a new library. Its six usage-pattern groups are exploratory rather than randomly assigned teaching strategies. Figure~\ref{fig:ch10-research-2} accordingly shows an immediate quiz comparison, not delayed retention. \autocite{W118}

nodes.label: An unresolved reporting detail makes restraint especially important. The source reports a 4.15-point difference on a 27-point quiz while describing a 17\% diffe
nodes.paragraph: An unresolved reporting detail makes restraint especially important. The source reports a 4.15-point difference on a 27-point quiz while describing a 17\% difference. Dividing the stated quantities does not reproduce that summary, and a different normalization cannot be assumed. The book therefore retains the reported direction of the immediate comparison without presenting a corrected relative skill-loss percentage. Participant-level observations and the intended calculation would be needed to settle it. \autocite{W118}

nodes.label: Ide's knowledge-transmission model asks a different question. Novices learn tacit knowledge through work with experienced people; changing which tasks they perf
nodes.paragraph: Ide's knowledge-transmission model asks a different question. Novices learn tacit knowledge through work with experienced people; changing which tasks they perform can alter future learning even when current output rises. That is a theoretical mechanism under specified assumptions, not a measured fall in developers' skills or employment. Earlier illustrative growth scenarios should not be attributed to a later version's result, and the versioned PDF is the fixed source where renderings disagree. \autocite{W120}

nodes.label: Historical work on onboarding, comprehension and novice learning supplies additional perspectives, with different participants, tasks, instruments and intervals
nodes.paragraph: Historical work on onboarding, comprehension and novice learning supplies additional perspectives, with different participants, tasks, instruments and intervals before assessment. Those differences matter as much as the tool used during the task. \autocite{W115,W161,W163,W164,W166,W167,W169,W170}

nodes.label: A policy survey tells us what a set of organizations has written. It does not tell us whether the policy is enforced, whether a tool cannot bypass it, or whethe
nodes.paragraph: A policy survey tells us what a set of organizations has written. It does not tell us whether the policy is enforced, whether a tool cannot bypass it, or whether its use improves delivery. W150 combines 245 policies found among 2,000 repositories with 36 deliberately added organizations. Results for that enriched sample should not be described as the prevalence of a practice across all repositories. Without the extra organizations' labels, even the corresponding discovered-policy rate cannot be recovered exactly. \autocite{W150}

nodes.label: Conceptual process proposals and simulated function-building studies contribute other kinds of insight. Their roles, coordination patterns and measured endpoint
nodes.paragraph: Conceptual process proposals and simulated function-building studies contribute other kinds of insight. Their roles, coordination patterns and measured endpoints cannot be pooled into a governance-effect estimate. The operating model in this book instead makes ownership, evidence freshness, conflict resolution and release authority explicit so those controls can be examined in a real workflow. \autocite{W152,W153,W148}

nodes.label: Organizational return claims need similar separation. Surveys and vendor material may contain reported benefits with self-selected denominators. The McKinsey ex
nodes.paragraph: Organizational return claims need similar separation. Surveys and vendor material may contain reported benefits with self-selected denominators. The McKinsey excerpt catalogued as W028 combines a bank case, potential leverage scenarios and a reference to a separate company analysis; its twentyfold frontier scenario is not an observed mean across that company sample. DORA's return-on-investment guidance and calculator are decision aids, not randomized demonstrations of a fixed return. \autocite{W026,W024,W028,W145}

nodes.label: The economic question is broader than whether a tool produces more code. Corporate output experiments, platform studies and labor-market analyses observe differ
nodes.paragraph: The economic question is broader than whether a tool produces more code. Corporate output experiments, platform studies and labor-market analyses observe different populations and endpoints. W003's output measure, W010's version-dependent platform estimates and W136's labor-market findings cannot be combined into a single accepted-change cost. Pre-adoption earnings differences are not treatment effects, and confidence bounds from different specifications are not interchangeable. \autocite{W003,W010,W136}

nodes.label: Workforce interpretation is particularly sensitive to the denominator. In Chandar and Klein Teeselink's analytic sample, a lower junior share is associated prim
nodes.paragraph: Workforce interpretation is particularly sensitive to the denominator. In Chandar and Klein Teeselink's analytic sample, a lower junior share is associated primarily with higher senior employment; the estimated junior-headcount reduction is not statistically significant. The matched-affiliate analysis is narrower than the large underlying postings and employment datasets, and its adoption measure and identification assumptions limit causal interpretation. A falling share is not, by itself, a measured decline in the total number of young workers. \autocite{W126}

nodes.label: Vacancies, employment, wages, occupational shares and firm spending remain separate outcomes. Forecasts and competing interpretations can help identify scenario
nodes.paragraph: Vacancies, employment, wages, occupational shares and firm spending remain separate outcomes. Forecasts and competing interpretations can help identify scenarios, but hiring cycles, remote work and capital constraints are alternative explanations that require appropriate designs. They should remain visible when discussing AI's possible contribution. \autocite{W019,W025,W127,W135,W138,W130,W142}

nodes.label: The \emph{70\% problem} and the discussion of apparently finished work make the gap between generation and delivery memorable. Their value is to draw attention
nodes.paragraph: The \emph{70\% problem} and the discussion of apparently finished work make the gap between generation and delivery memorable. Their value is to draw attention to the remaining integration, review and rework, not to establish a measured completion percentage. The book uses that distinction to ask what an accepted change actually costs. \osmanicite{O049,O029}

nodes.label: Agency and orchestration describe different choices. One agent can have consequential authority in a single workspace, while a team of read-only agents can requ
nodes.paragraph: Agency and orchestration describe different choices. One agent can have consequential authority in a single workspace, while a team of read-only agents can require coordination without permission to alter policy. Osmani's illustrative autonomy levels help name possible arrangements, but do not constitute a validated maturity scale. \osmanicite{O010}

nodes.label: Loop mechanisms make some of the responsibilities concrete: scheduling, isolated work, versioned procedures, governed connectors, specialist tasks and durable p
nodes.paragraph: Loop mechanisms make some of the responsibilities concrete: scheduling, isolated work, versioned procedures, governed connectors, specialist tasks and durable progress state. Their presence should make the work easier to observe and bound. A specialist subagent is not independent merely because it has a separate name, and a stopped loop has not thereby earned release permission. \osmanicite{O012,O006}

nodes.label: The same distinction applies to specifications. A well-formed machine-authored contract can be an excellent proposal while still lacking authorization. Osmani's
nodes.paragraph: The same distinction applies to specifications. A well-formed machine-authored contract can be an excellent proposal while still lacking authorization. Osmani's specification guidance helps make a task explicit; the policy owner remains responsible for its business meaning. In the approval service, a late Treasury revision requires that decision before the model is asked to implement it. \osmanicite{O018,O028}

nodes.label: The recommendation to treat generated code as a draft and the later discussion of code nobody can fully read address a changing review burden. They are more use
nodes.paragraph: The recommendation to treat generated code as a draft and the later discussion of code nobody can fully read address a changing review burden. They are more useful as a tension to resolve than as opposing universal rules. A bounded change can rely on strong independent checks, while a high-impact change still needs appropriate domain judgment and accountable acceptance. Neither essay supplies a universally safe proportion of code that humans may stop inspecting. \osmanicite{O023,O001}

nodes.label: Brownfield delegation and context management extend the responsibility beyond a single run. A change zone, instruction file or checkpoint can preserve useful in
nodes.paragraph: Brownfield delegation and context management extend the responsibility beyond a single run. A change zone, instruction file or checkpoint can preserve useful information, but can also preserve a stale assumption. Version, owner, source and invalidation conditions make that information usable without silently promoting a summary into authority. The memory arrangement then needs a handoff test, not merely successful retrieval. \osmanicite{O002,O031,O013,O004}

nodes.label: Warnings about agentic skill decay and the \emph{80\% problem} bring the engineer back into view. They raise questions about lost practice, comprehension and re
nodes.paragraph: Warnings about agentic skill decay and the \emph{80\% problem} bring the engineer back into view. They raise questions about lost practice, comprehension and responsibility rather than provide population estimates of competence. The proposed delayed-transfer evaluation is one way to investigate those concerns without assuming their conclusion. \osmanicite{O003,O017}

nodes.label: ``Own the outer loop'' connects these themes. People remain responsible for intention, evaluation design, escalation and operational consequences while delegati
nodes.paragraph: ``Own the outer loop'' connects these themes. People remain responsible for intention, evaluation design, escalation and operational consequences while delegating bounded inner work. That prescription is a useful basis for designing responsibilities; its value should be judged through the actual effort, releases, incidents and learning it enables. \osmanicite{O009}

nodes.label: Orosz and Laura Tacho's measurement discussion connects tool adoption with delivery, quality and developer experience. It motivates the book's measurement-to-de
nodes.paragraph: Orosz and Laura Tacho's measurement discussion connects tool adoption with delivery, quality and developer experience. It motivates the book's measurement-to-decision table, without validating that proposed instrument or supplying the approval service's acceptance probabilities. At publication, the article disclosed Orosz's investment in DX, Tacho's role there and that the article was not sponsored. Those relationships accompany the reported practices and should remain part of their interpretation. \oroszcite{P061}

nodes.label: The discussion of loop engineering supplies a useful challenge to Osmani's vocabulary: does the additional coordinator still earn its complexity when existing t
nodes.paragraph: The discussion of loop engineering supplies a useful challenge to Osmani's vocabulary: does the additional coordinator still earn its complexity when existing tooling can provide some mechanisms? This concerns implementation, not the disappearance of engineering responsibilities. The article discusses the underlying Osmani work through another edition; it is neither independent confirmation of that work nor a universal refutation of controlled loops. \oroszcite{P110}

nodes.label: Drew Hoskins's diagnostic-design excerpt, introduced through Orosz's interview, helps explain why an error message is part of behavior rather than decoration. A
nodes.paragraph: Drew Hoskins's diagnostic-design excerpt, introduced through Orosz's interview, helps explain why an error message is part of behavior rather than decoration. A conflict should identify the condition and a permitted next step. It should not encourage a caller to overwrite a historical decision or evade policy by retrying with a new key. The diagnostic contract in the exercise is this book's adaptation of that guidance. \oroszcite{P082}

nodes.label: Orosz and Elin Nilsson's Antithesis report offers a related debugging lesson: preserve the conditions that make a failure reproducible. Its company account does
nodes.paragraph: Orosz and Elin Nilsson's Antithesis report offers a related debugging lesson: preserve the conditions that make a failure reproducible. Its company account does not turn the book's lost-response pseudocode into an executed simulator, and deterministic repetition still does not establish that the oracle is correct. A later free-access or sponsorship notice also remains separate from the original article's publication context. \oroszcite{P006}

nodes.label: The visible discussion of code-review practice sharpens another distinction. A human can resolve every model comment while an important obligation remains untes
nodes.paragraph: The visible discussion of code-review practice sharpens another distinction. A human can resolve every model comment while an important obligation remains untested. The proposed coverage ledger therefore asks what evidence supports historical replay, not just whether the reviewer has anything left to say. Reported company practices do not supply a universal release policy. \oroszcite{P118}

nodes.label: Kent Beck's optimistic discussion of AI as a learning amplifier provides a counter-hypothesis to lost practice. In the edited panel, Orosz is the credited autho
nodes.paragraph: Kent Beck's optimistic discussion of AI as a learning amplifier provides a counter-hypothesis to lost practice. In the edited panel, Orosz is the credited author and moderator; Beck and Martin Fowler are participants. Their interpretation motivates a question, not a measured effect. The book's two assisted-work conditions test structured practice and cannot establish AI's total effect by comparison with an unassisted group. \oroszcite{P123}

nodes.label: Nicole Forsgren and Abi Noda's \emph{Frictionless} excerpts, introduced through Orosz's interview, focus attention on the conditions in which engineers work. Th
nodes.paragraph: Nicole Forsgren and Abi Noda's \emph{Frictionless} excerpts, introduced through Orosz's interview, focus attention on the conditions in which engineers work. The useful transfer is to distinguish repeated preparation and missing evidence from the assurance work and policy decisions a team genuinely needs. Improving how a control is performed is different from deleting its purpose. \oroszcite{P078}

nodes.label: The economic examples close the circle. Orosz's personal replacement of a small service and his Simon Eskildsen interview about rough resource reasoning encoura
nodes.paragraph: The economic examples close the circle. Orosz's personal replacement of a small service and his Simon Eskildsen interview about rough resource reasoning encourage scrutiny of scope and assumptions. A quick implementation does not include all the obligations of maintaining an equivalent service. Rough bounds can identify what should be measured; a headline build time or reported saving cannot become a local model coefficient. \oroszcite{P084,P111}

nodes.label: Publication count can exaggerate independent support. P014 is an edited republication of Osmani's O049 with added commentary. Its second publication does not cr
nodes.paragraph: Publication count can exaggerate independent support. P014 is an edited republication of Osmani's O049 with added commentary. Its second publication does not create a second observation. P052 reports the experiment already catalogued as W023; the primary sixteen-developer, 246-issue, issue-randomized design remains authoritative where the secondary description differs. \oroszcite{P014,P052}

nodes.label: Similarly, P089, P095 and P101 analyze one voluntary reader cohort. Distinct questions justify distinct articles, but not three independent samples or a matched
nodes.paragraph: Similarly, P089, P095 and P101 analyze one voluntary reader cohort. Distinct questions justify distinct articles, but not three independent samples or a matched longitudinal panel. The survey can contain primary descriptive observations without establishing causation or population-wide effects. Overlapping Summit context also limits the independence of related panel reporting. \oroszcite{P089,P095,P101}

nodes.label: Some remaining questions require original observations. W003's estimators need the underlying assignment and task records for an independent refit. W068's discr
nodes.paragraph: Some remaining questions require original observations. W003's estimators need the underlying assignment and task records for an independent refit. W068's discrepant table count needs matched repository records rather than an inferred replacement. W170's retained activity shares require participant logs to reconcile them. Until those materials are analyzed, the book keeps the affected interpretations qualified. \autocite{W003,W068,W170}

nodes.label: Other questions concern the connection between a model or instrument and the world. W120's theoretical assumptions need to be examined separately from real know
nodes.paragraph: Other questions concern the connection between a model or instrument and the world. W120's theoretical assumptions need to be examined separately from real knowledge transfer. W150's original policy classifications need independent inspection before a stronger coding-validity claim. W151's paired and seed-level results need their endpoint definitions and observations before its statistical summaries can be reproduced. These dependencies are different; more citations do not resolve any of them. \autocite{W120,W150,W151}

nodes.contribution: Distinguishes the why loop that pursues outcomes from nested how loops that build software. Proposes human work on the loop: improving guidance, checks and workflow rather than only editing individual outputs.
nodes.limitation: A conceptual operating model. Its proposed agentic improvement flywheel is not a demonstrated organizational or reliability result.
nodes.source_locator: Body: why/how loops; humans outside, in and on the loop; flywheel

nodes.label: Viability of local models for coding
nodes.date_provenance: Dated entry on the supplied series index; article date also used where printed
nodes.contribution: Frames local agentic coding as a combined hardware, model, runtime, context and tool-calling problem. The account separates being able to run a model from obtaining usable results.
nodes.limitation: A personal hardware/tool snapshot. Explanations for observed configuration differences are hypotheses; code quality was not systematically evaluated.
nodes.source_locator: Scope; factors influencing viability; context size and harness; conclusions
nodes.verification_scope: Primary article byline and selected body passages inspected; no independent execution or statistical replication

nodes.label: Experiences with local models for coding
nodes.date_provenance: Dated entry on the supplied series index; article date also used where printed
nodes.contribution: Presents a viability funnel and compares manual trials, a small automated evaluation and everyday local-model use. Outcome sensitivity to task, context and configuration makes simple capability claims difficult.
nodes.limitation: Two principal JavaScript/TypeScript tasks and small uneven repeat counts; one-shot automated trials differ from interactive work and do not establish a general ranking.
nodes.source_locator: Viability funnel; two task descriptions; manual/automated phases; day-to-day use

nodes.label: The Economic Benefit of Refactoring
nodes.date_provenance: Dated entry on the supplied series index; article date also used where printed
nodes.contribution: Repeats one representative change as a large Rust data-access module is refactored. Estimated input-token use falls after decomposition permits more selective code reading, connecting architecture to inference work.
nodes.limitation: One application and change, approximate token counting and incomplete refactoring-cost accounting; this does not establish general ROI or savings for every future task.

nodes.label: TDD inside the agent loop - theater or actual value?
nodes.date_provenance: Dated entry on the supplied series index; article date also used where printed
nodes.contribution: Separates human-authored tests, a human review checkpoint and TDD entirely inside an agent loop. The small exploratory comparison found no clear advantage for fully internal TDD in model-judged quality or mutation scores.
nodes.limitation: Small greenfield tasks, imperfect adherence and an LLM-defined quality rubric. Reported aggregate tokens include cache rereads and are not equivalent to billed cost; no universal conclusion about human-led TDD follows.
nodes.source_locator: Setup; results; test-first and red-green goals; costs; conclusions

nodes.label: An Accidental Blackboard
nodes.date_provenance: Dated entry on the supplied series index; article date also used where printed
nodes.contribution: In a simulated airline exercise, shared plans and frequent repository updates became an improvised coordination surface for agents. The account connects this behavior with the blackboard pattern and describes resulting CI pressure.
nodes.limitation: A practice exercise, not a deployed airline system. The author explicitly questions reproducibility; the coordination mechanism was emergent rather than experimentally isolated.

nodes.label: Are Harnesses Worth the Cost?
nodes.date_provenance: Dated entry on the supplied series index; article date also used where printed
nodes.contribution: Compares development with and without a behavioral harness against a separate acceptance suite. On the selected service, the stronger model passed both conditions; a cost-optimized model passed more consistently with harness feedback, at greater per-attempt effort.
nodes.limitation: Ten paired runs per model on one unusually detailed greenfield Java brief. Guides and sensors changed together; estimated generation costs omit harness authoring, review and repairs. Final-gate-only use is proposed, not tested.

edges.reading_passage: The timeline in Figure~\ref{fig:ch01-research-1} can be read as an expansion of engineering concerns, rather than a succession of methods that erase their predecessors. Agentic work still needs the process, risk and operational disciplines represented to its left. The emerging engineer's role therefore includes decomposing a problem, choosing what may safely be delegated, building independent checks and making the reasoning behind acceptance available to other people. Which activities grow or shrink under AI adoption remains a research question; the conceptual distinction is between authorship of an artifact and responsibility for its consequences.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: The return path in Figure~\ref{fig:ch01-research-2} makes the lifecycle revisable: operational experience can reopen requirements, while human control spans every stage rather than appearing only at the end. An approved intention is a living, versioned contract for a bounded change. If a policy owner clarifies an approval threshold after implementation, the new fact enters as an authorized delta. The team then revisits the affected design assumptions, tests and knowledge records, retaining earlier evidence for the earlier version. This selective invalidation keeps the workflow incremental rather than restarting the entire lifecycle.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: Return to the request to make a department's approval ceiling configurable. An agent can produce a patch before anyone has decided whether ``approval'' means eligibility, escalation or final authorization. To prevent that ambiguity from becoming a hidden software rule, trace the request through a sequence of decisions, each with a different source of authority. In Figure~\ref{fig:ch01-change-acceptance}, the patch sits between authorization and verification; the role labels beneath the boxes identify who is responsible for each decision. Moving right requires the corresponding evidence or approval, not merely another artifact from the maker.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: Two experiments can disagree without one being defective. Becker and colleagues studied sixteen experienced open-source developers completing 246 tasks in repositories they knew well. In their early-2025 tool setting, allowing AI increased completion time by about 19\%. Developers had expected acceleration, and after participating still believed the tool had helped. Paradis and colleagues\textquotesingle{} Google trial instead estimated a roughly 21\% reduction in task time in its own environment. \autocite{W023,W008} Figure~\ref{fig:ch02-research-1} isolates the first study's disagreement: both subjective estimates fall below zero, meaning less task time, while the measured effect is above zero. Retrospective confidence therefore remains a different signal from timed performance.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: The redistribution in Figure~\ref{fig:ch02-research-2} explains why the service pilot must record supervision as well as construction: prompting, waiting and reviewing outputs become part of the task. The rectangles name activities, not equal amounts of time or measured savings. Collect short post-task reports on perceived effort, confidence and comprehension alongside independently logged time, including test repairs and stakeholder clarification. An engineer who finishes faster but loses understanding of the policy may create future costs. Chapter~\ref{chap:10} returns to that learning question; the pilot should preserve the signal rather than discard it.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: The exchange in Figure~\ref{fig:ch03-research-1} connects human intent and acceptance with the agent's bounded execution through versioned evidence packs. For the service, the outgoing task carries the contract and permissions; the returning pack contains the candidate diff and a trace of what was read and executed. The feedback paths let either side request clarification without turning a tool result into policy. This separation lets us evaluate capability without granting merge, release or policy-approval authority.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: The position on Figure~\ref{fig:osmani-agency-orchestration} never supplies its own approval. For each configuration, record the writable scope, expected independent evidence, rollback mechanism, review capacity and named acceptance owner. Expand either axis only when observed accepted outcomes justify the added complexity; a higher level is not automatically better.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: The spread in Figure~\ref{fig:ch03-research-2} illustrates why task mix matters: documentation changes had a higher merged share than performance changes in the sampled corpus. The bars summarize repository and reviewer decisions, not probabilities for our next task. They motivate separate evaluation of task classes, while leaving the causes of the differences open.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: For the same INT-002 task, first name the control missing from the simpler route. Is it a permission check, durable progress state, independent evidence, or an escalation path? Add a mechanism only with a testable account of how it supplies that control. Where the simpler route already meets the contract, extra scheduling or coordination is an additional maintenance obligation rather than a maturity achievement. Figure~\ref{fig:controls_execution_P110} separates these decisions.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: Figure~\ref{fig:ch04-research-1} shows where the ledger enters execution. The authorized contract constrains deterministic workflow code; the model contributes subtask content and uses only the permitted tools. The right-hand ``verified result'' denotes an output checked within that scope, not authorization to change the contract or release the service. Behavioral examples must supply the expectations against which such an output is judged.
edges.interpretation: Editorial linkage, not a new empirical-evidence relation

edges.reading_passage: Hassan\textquotesingle s roadmap \autocite{W152} and research on rejected agent PRs \autocite{W071} motivate coordination and review without establishing an optimal gate sequence. Figure~\ref{fig:ch04-research-2} makes our proposed sequence explicit: validate the authorized delta before asking the model for a new patch, then rerun the affected contracts and independent checks. The dashed return brings unresolved evidence back to the control layer; it does not let the model silently rewrite intention. This keeps a late requirement small enough to trace without regenerating the entire system.

edges.rationale: Piccolo incremento riguarda l’unità semantica; un item riguarda il ciclo.
Il parallelismo può usare worktree ma richiede anche coordinamento e integrazione.
Costo del modello esteso a verifica, review e mantenimento per esito.
Mantenere genealogia, precisare costituzione versionata.
Chiarimento prima delle decisioni che ne dipendono.
Coerenza è un controllo del gate, non tutto il gate.
Persistenza della ricerca e consegna tra ruoli sono responsabilità diverse.
Esplorare due implementazioni non è dibattito di due modelli.
Score diagnostico non può valere come autorizzazione al gate.
Convergenza di ragioni non equivale a prova indipendente.
Critica avversariale e maker–checker condividono separazione, non garanzie di indipendenza.
Chiamate tool sono una dimensione del budget, non un costo universale.
Titolare, motivo e arresto restano espliciti.
Immutabilità della revisione coesiste con evoluzione autorizzata, non con contratto immutabile per sempre.
Persistenza di lezioni non è fine-tuning dei pesi.
Isolamento delle scritture e ownership del target risolvono problemi diversi.
